name: PROGNOS for Aircraft
summary: In-house predictive maintenance suite that analyzes aircraft sensor data and alerts 30 to 50 flights before a fault; used by Virgin Atlantic and Norse Atlantic.
paragraphs: In-house predictive maintenance suite that analyzes aircraft sensor data and alerts 30 to 50 flights before a fault; used by Virgin Atlantic and Norse Atlantic.
whyItMatters: AFI KLM E&M reports no 'no fault found' results across hundreds of predictive removals, a useful benchmark when comparing vendors.
